meta.name: google-agents-cli-scaffold
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "create an agent project", "start a new ADK project", "build me a new agent", "add CI/CD to my project", "add deployment", "enhance my project", or "upgrade my project". Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Covers `agents-cli scaffold create`, `scaffold enhance`, and `scaffold upgrade` commands, template options, deployment targets, and the prototype-first workflow. Do NOT use for writing agent code (ADK projects: use google-agents-cli-adk-code) or deployment operations (use google-agents-cli-deploy).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从零搭好 Agent 项目骨架,顺带配齐 CI/CD 与部署模板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚想动手做一个 AI Agent 项目,却不想从目录结构开始折腾。
copy.tagline_en: Scaffold a ready-to-run agent project and wire up CI/CD from the start.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to start an AI agent project without hand-building its structure.

howto.what: 它会用 agents-cli 帮你新建 agent 项目(默认 ADK Python,可选 Go)、给已有项目加上部署目标和 CI/CD,或把项目升级到新版;脚手架文件由命令行生成,不靠手写。
howto.when: 当你说要「创建 agent 项目」、要给项目「加部署或 CI/CD」、或「升级项目」时接管;写 agent 代码和实际部署由其他技能负责。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 ADK 的 agent 项目,先做原型、暂不部署
给我的项目加上 GitHub Actions 的 CI/CD
say.note: 会先确认选项,再执行 scaffold enhance

say.text: 把这个项目升级到新版 agents-cli,先给我看改动

howto.what_en: It uses agents-cli to scaffold a new agent project (ADK Python by default, Go optional), add deployment or CI/CD to an existing one, or upgrade to a newer agents-cli version. Files are CLI-generated, not hand-written.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create an agent project, add deployment or CI/CD to a project, or upgrade a project. Writing agent code and actual deployment are handled by other skills.

say_en.text: Create a new ADK agent project as a prototype, no deployment yet
say_en.note: Runs scaffold create --prototype after clarifying needs

say_en.text: Add GitHub Actions CI/CD to my project
say_en.note: Confirms options, then runs scaffold enhance

say_en.text: Upgrade this project to the latest agents-cli, show me changes first
